note: County tax deed sales (RealAuction, Bid4Assets for Okaloosa).
eligibility_basis: F.S. 197.502(6) and 197.542(1), read 2026-10-05, provide for the clerk's public sale of tax deeds with a statutory opening bid; 46 county sale sites are read in production (fl_realauction, fl_bid4assets_okaloosa).
meaning: A clerk's tax deed sale: the property itself is sold to the highest bidder at a scheduled public auction.
office: Clerk of the Circuit Court and Comptroller (per county)

note: Lands Available for Taxes lists, county by county.
eligibility_basis: F.S. 197.502(7), read 2026-10-05: property not sold at the tax deed sale is entered on the list of lands available for taxes and may be purchased for the opening bid after 90 days; 32 county lists are read in production.
meaning: Property that failed to sell at a tax deed sale, purchasable from the clerk without an auction (Lands Available for Taxes).
office: Clerk of the Circuit Court and Comptroller (per county)

note: County tax certificates (LienHub).
eligibility_basis: F.S. 197.502(6)(a)-(b), read 2026-10-05, provide for tax deed applications on county-held and individually held tax certificates - the certificate is the statewide instrument. The certificate sale itself (F.S. 197.432) has not been read. 32 county-held certificate lists are read in production (fl_lienhub_certificates).
meaning: A tax certificate: a lien on the property for unpaid taxes, bought by assignment from the county. It is not ownership of the land.

note: Sheriff / county tax sales (LGBS, RealAuction) - manual harvest only.
eligibility_basis: Tax foreclosure sales are run county by county: 24 county sheriff-sale sites (tx_realauction) and LGBS sale listings are read on request, and Galveston County Sheriff's own sale procedures are a verified evidence row. Tex. Tax Code ch. 34 itself has not been read (lead only).
meaning: A sheriff's or constable's tax foreclosure sale of the property under a court judgment.
office: County Sheriff or Constable; delinquent-tax counsel for the taxing units

note: Struck-off property offered for resale (LGBS) - manual harvest only.
eligibility_basis: LGBS lists property struck off to taxing units, but whether, when and how a taxing unit resells it (Tex. Tax Code 34.05, lead only) is set per taxing unit and has not been verified from any official page. Harris County's tax office list (tx_hctax) is restricted pending legal review; other county struck-off pages are unreviewed candidates. Struck-off property is not automatically for sale at a fixed price.
meaning: Property struck off to a taxing unit after no sufficient bid, which the unit may later resell under its own process.
office: Taxing units (county, city, school district) and their delinquent-tax counsel
